messages:
Priya (support): ACME (tenant acme-v2) is getting a 400 when calling a tool; they call 'translateText' but we renamed it to 'translate_text' last week. Error from API:

```json
{"error":"unknown_tool_handle","message":"tool 'translateText' not found","code":400}
```

They say it's only failing from their Dedicated/private deployment; our hosted console calls using 'translate_text' succeed.

Daniel (eng-runtime): Can you paste the failing request (headers + body) and tenant id?

Priya (support): Here's a sanitized curl they ran (kept headers):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'X-Tenant: acme-v2' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tool":"translateText","args":{"text":"hello","target_lang":"es"}}'
```

Priya (support): Response is the JSON error above. Calls from our console with 'translate_text' work.

Daniel (eng-runtime): Sounds like alias/registry drift on the private agent or a client-side cache. Quick checks:
- Dump tenant registry from private control plane: GET /admin/tenants/acme-v2/tools
- Try calling by tool UUID to confirm resolution

Priya (support): Pulled registry (sanitized):

```json
[
  {"id":"uuid-translate-0001","name":"translate_text","aliases":["TranslateText"],"updated_at":"2026-03-10T12:04:00Z"},
  {"id":"uuid-summarize-0002","name":"summarize","aliases":[],"updated_at":"2026-02-28T09:12:00Z"}
]
```

Priya (support): Note alias is 'TranslateText' (capital T) while customer used 'translateText' (camel). Maybe casefold mismatch.

Anika (eng-platform): Private agents apply casefold + alias sync but alias backfills have a TTL. If the backfill push was missed the local mapping can lag. Check ops-bot for last push timestamp.

ops-bot: Backfill push for tenant acme-v2 to private-agent-7 completed at 2026-03-10T12:05:12Z. Agent restart at 2026-03-10T12:09:30Z.

Daniel (eng-runtime): Immediate actions:
1) Workaround: call by tool_id UUID in payload. Example:

```json
{"tool_id":"uuid-translate-0001","args":{"text":"hello","target_lang":"es"}}
```

Or set header X-Redwood-Allow-UUID: true if client supports it.

2) Fix: trigger alias backfill / flush client cache on the agent and verify casefold rules.

Priya (support): Customer tried UUID call and it succeeded. They swapped to tool_id and got 200 with expected response.

Maya (support): Customer wants a permanent fix so they don't change code.

Anika (eng-platform): Triggering targeted backfill to private-agent-7 and forcing alias sync now:

```bash
./infra/scripts/alias_backfill --tenant acme-v2 --agent private-agent-7 --force
```

Anika (eng-platform): Backfill started; ETA ~7m. Also adding an alert for alias/version drift >5m.

ops-bot: Alias backfill job for acme-v2 on private-agent-7 completed at 2026-03-16T22:14:37Z. Aliases normalized (translateText -> translate_text).

Priya (support): Customer confirmed calls with 'translateText' now resolve and return 200. Closing escalation. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Daniel (eng-runtime): I'll follow up with a client library patch to prefer case-insensitive alias resolution and add tests.

Anika (eng-platform): Adding runbook steps for manual backfills and monitoring. :white_check_mark:

Priya (support): Filing a short postmortem and adding tenant to watchlist for 24h. Closing thread.
